weekly.purpose: Macro trend direction and major structure — defines the dominant bias

daily.purpose: Primary swing timeframe — bias confirmation and setup identification

4h.purpose: Entry timing and trade management — refine entries within daily bias

bullish.ema_position: Price above the 50 EMA and the 50 EMA above the 200 EMA on daily; weekly close above the 50 EMA
bullish.rsi_range: Daily RSI(14) holding between 40 and 80; pullbacks find support in the 40-50 zone
bullish.market_structure: Higher highs and higher lows on weekly and daily; most recent swing low undisturbed

bearish.ema_position: Price below the 50 EMA and the 50 EMA below the 200 EMA on daily; weekly close below the 50 EMA
bearish.rsi_range: Daily RSI(14) holding between 20 and 60; rallies stall in the 50-60 zone
bearish.market_structure: Lower highs and lower lows on weekly and daily; most recent swing high undisturbed

bias_criteria.neutral: If timeframes conflict or price is chopping between the 50 and 200 EMA, stand aside — no trade

risk_rules.position_sizing: Size each position so the distance from entry to stop equals at most 1% of account equity
risk_rules.stop_loss: Always set a hard stop beyond the invalidating swing point before entry
no_trade_conditions: Bias is neutral or timeframes conflict
Within 24h of major macro events without a defined plan
